name: The Silent Ascent
desc:
Using only your grappling hook to traverse a realm of towering grey pillars, mysterious biomes, dangerous creatures, and strange inhabitants. 

- Every climb is different, each Ascent is randomly generated.
- Play solo, or bring your friends!
- Create a party to work together!
- Collect Essence to purchase hats and faces, and style your perfect climber.

Controls
Click / Right Trigger - Grapple
E / D-Pad Up - Reel In
Q / D-Pad Down - Reel Out
Jump (At Wall) - Climb
H / D-Pad Left - Call Out

The Silent Ascent launched on April 13th, 2026.
The game is currently in Beta.
This game is currently being worked on by one developer, I'm trying my best to keep updates consistent!
v2.0.0

scripts.title: thesilentascend script
scripts.features: Teleports to essences. (you can change the teleport speed after the task.wait)
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local visited = {}

while task.wait(0.4) do
    local character = player.Character
    if character then
        for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if v.Name == "Essence"
                and v:IsA("BasePart")
                and v.Parent
                and not visited[v] then

                visited[v] = true
                character:PivotTo(v.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                task.wait(0.4)
            end
        end
    end

    -- Clean up entries for removed objects
    for part in pairs(visited) do
        if not part.Parent then
            visited[part] = nil
        end
    end
end
